span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EACH PERSON'S COMMUNITY IS MORE STABLE THAN THE POPULATION IS UNIFORM: variation within a subject over time is consistently smaller than variation between subjects, in composition and in function alike
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A DIVERSITY SPLIT THAT REVERSES BY HABITAT: saliva is among the richest within a person and among the most similar across people, while skin is the opposite - so one number for diversity would hide the pattern entirely
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE PAPER'S OWN NEGATIVE RESULT: most variation in the human microbiome is not well explained by the phenotypic metadata collected, and even the strongest associations carry low effect sizes and considerable unexplained variance
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 'Healthy' is defined by an exclusion list rather than by a positive criterion, and the paper marks the word as its own stipulation

span.label: No taxon was found in every habitat and every individual at this sequencing depth - so the absence is bounded by the depth, not asserted of the biology
